answers.core: If implemented, I think this feature would be used a high percentage of the time when awaiting a signal would happen, as it lets the developer utilize CancellationTokens with signals.
answers.workaround: can be worked around as a complex extension method as shown above, which is overly complex for most developers to implement on their own.
